notes_for_editor: Only one source places this tower: the tnlandforms.us compiled list, row GA032, no GFC or BLL code on the row. Searches and the local caches found no Franklin County or Georgia Liberty tower history, and no Georgia Forestry Commission record. The Liberty Lookout Tower on the National Historic Lookout Register (nhlr.org/lookouts/us/tn/liberty-lookout-tower/) is in Tennessee; do not conflate. The NHLR Georgia state list (29 entries) does not include this tower. The list gives elevation with no unit; the brief's 244.1 m assumes feet, and the tower record's elevation_m is that conversion, so the metre figure is unverified. Fact-check 2026-10-21: removed the claim that this tower's name comes from the USGS name database, because the map caption only says towers numbered 1 to 72 are listed that way. Story is about 113 words, in line with the guide's length for thin sources; the editor may prefer to hold it as a stub. No photos. Next checks if time allows: Georgia Forestry Commission tower records, Franklin County or Lavonia and Carnesville newspaper archives, and the NHLR Former Fire Lookout Sites register.
